name: findsure
description: FindSure — Know before you go. Local business trust & freshness MVP.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c teal,blue "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:migrate --prefix server && npm run db:seed --prefix server
